descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Corporate Communication Manager, farai parte del team Corporate Communication & Public Affairs e contribuirai a rafforzare la reputazione di SMG attraverso una comunicazione chiara, coerente e di grande impatto.

Riportando al Responsabile delle comunicazioni aziendali e degli affari pubblici, lavorerai su un'ampia gamma di argomenti di comunicazione aziendale a livello di gruppo, con particolare attenzione alle relazioni con i media e alle comunicazioni finanziarie. Supporterai inoltre la comunicazione interna e selezionati progetti di comunicazione strategica, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli investitori, il senior management e i responsabili della comunicazione delle nostre business unit.

Responsabilità

• Supportare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie e concetti di comunicazione aziendale in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali di SMG

• Gestire le attività di relazioni con i media, comprese le richieste dei media, il monitoraggio dei media, i comunicati stampa, le dichiarazioni, le domande e risposte e le attività dei portavoce

• Gestire le relazioni con i media e le attività di PR per le attività finanziarie e assicurative di SMG, lavorando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate aziendali rilevanti

• Supportare la comunicazione finanziaria in stretta collaborazione con le relazioni con gli investitori, compresi i risultati annuali e semestrali, la relazione annuale e l'assemblea generale annuale

• Sostenere il posizionamento dei dirigenti di livello C attraverso messaggi chiave, punti di discussione, presentazioni e contenuti di comunicazione

• Supportare le comunicazioni interne su argomenti a livello di Gruppo e adattare i contenuti per i gruppi target e i canali interni rilevanti

• Supportare la comunicazione su argomenti e progetti strategici a livello di Gruppo, come la sostenibilità e la sicurezza informatica

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il senior management, i responsabili delle comunicazioni delle unità aziendali e altri principali stakeholder interni

• Coordinare agenzie e partner esterni ove richiesto

##Qualifiche

• Laurea triennale o magistrale (FH, Università) in comunicazione, giornalismo, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato

• Oltre 5 anni di esperienza nella comunicazione aziendale

• Esperienza nelle relazioni con i media e buona conoscenza del panorama mediatico svizzero

• Esperienza o forte interesse per le comunicazioni sui mercati finanziari e dei capitali

• Eccellenti capacità di scrittura ed editoriali e capacità di tradurre argomenti complessi in una comunicazione chiara e orientata al gruppo target

• Fiducia nel lavorare con le parti interessate senior e nel gestire argomenti di comunicazione delicati o urgenti

• Forti capacità organizzative e capacità di gestire diversi argomenti e scadenze in parallelo

• Stile di lavoro pragmatico, pratico e collaborativo con un elevato livello di affidabilità e attenzione alla qualità

• Interesse per i modelli di business digitali e il settore tecnologico

• Obbligatoria conoscenza fluente del tedesco e dell'inglese, sia scritto che parlato

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Cosa offriamo?

• 6 settimane di vacanze all'anno (più possibilità di acquistarne 10 extra)

• Settimana lavorativa di 40 ore con orario flessibile (limitato a 45 ore)

• Una configurazione di lavoro ibrida con flessibilità per lavorare in remoto

• Congedo parentale generoso: 18 settimane per maternità e 6 settimane per paternità/adozione

• Abbonamento metà-prezzo FFS e viaggi in prima classe tra gli uffici SMG in Svizzera

• Retribuzione neutrale rispetto al genere e percorsi di carriera trasparenti

• Scegli la tua attrezzatura: laptop Mac o Windows e cellulare iPhone, Samsung o Pixel

• Un ambiente inclusivo e innovativo in cui la tua voce conta

Processo di reclutamento
Continuiamo ad assumere persone semplici e umane (tieni presente che questo è un ruolo di Corporate Communication Manager, aspettati di essere messo alla prova):

• Videochiamata iniziale con uno dei nostri reclutatori (video 30 min)

• Intervista al responsabile delle assunzioni (video 60 min)

• Colloquio tecnico (video 45 min)

• Conversazione Team Fit e incontro con le parti interessate aziendali rilevanti (in loco 60 minuti)

Candidati ora

Per sfruttare questa grande opportunità, inviaci il tuo CV dettagliato e sentiti libero di includere eventuali documenti giustificativi che ci aiuteranno a capire perché sei la persona perfetta.

#LI-Ibrido

Chi siamo
SMG Swiss Marketplace Group è una rete pionieristica di mercati online e un’azienda digitale all’avanguardia che semplifica la vita delle persone con prodotti innovativi.

SMG Swiss Marketplace Group offre ai clienti gli strumenti migliori per soddisfare le loro esigenze decisionali di vita. Il portafoglio comprende immobili (ImmoScout24, Homegate, Flatfox, CASASOFT, IAZI), automobili (AutoScout24, MotoScout24), mercati generali (anibis.ch, tutti.ch, Ricardo) e finanza e assicurazioni (FinanceScout24, moneyland.ch).

Dichiarazione di non responsabilità
SMG Swiss Marketplace Group si impegna principalmente con i candidati in modo diretto. Non accettiamo curriculum o profili di candidati non richiesti da agenzie di reclutamento a meno che non abbiamo specificamente richiesto la loro assistenza per ruoli particolari. Qualsiasi invio effettuato senza una previa richiesta da parte del nostro team di acquisizione talenti non sarà riconosciuto o preso in considerazione. Apprezziamo la comprensione e la cooperazione delle agenzie di reclutamento nel rispetto di questa politica.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As Corporate Communication Manager, you will be part of the Corporate Communication & Public Affairs team and contribute to strengthening SMG’s reputation through clear, consistent and impactful communication.

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Communications & Public Affairs, you will work across a broad range of Group-level corporate communication topics, with a particular focus on media relations and financial communications. You will also support internal communications and selected strategic communication projects, working closely with Investor Relations, Senior Management and the Communication Managers of our Business Units.

Responsibilities

• Support the development and implementation of corporate communication strategies and concepts aligned with SMG’s business objectives

• Manage media relations activities, including media enquiries, media monitoring, press releases, statements, Q&As and spokesperson activities

• Manage media relations and PR activities for SMG’s Finance & Insurance business, working closely with the relevant business stakeholders

• Support financial communications in close collaboration with Investor Relations, including annual and half-year results, the Annual Report and the Annual General Meeting

• Support the positioning of C-level executives through key messages, speaking points, presentations and communication content

• Support internal communications on Group-wide topics and adapt content for relevant internal target groups and channels

• Support communication for Group-wide strategic topics and projects, such as sustainability and cybersecurity

• Work closely with senior management, Business Unit Communication Managers and other key internal stakeholders

• Coordinate external agencies and partners where required

## Qualifiche

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (FH, University) in Communications, Journalism, Business Administration or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in corporate communications

• Experience in media relations and a good understanding of the Swiss media landscape

• Experience in or strong interest in financial and capital markets communications

• Excellent writing and editorial skills and the ability to translate complex topics into clear and target-group-oriented communication

• Confidence in working with senior stakeholders and in handling sensitive or time-critical communication topics

• Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several topics and deadlines in parallel

• Pragmatic, hands-on and collaborative working style with a high level of reliability and attention to quality

• Interest in digital business models and the technology sector

• Fluent German and English mandatory, both written and spoken

## Informazioni aggiuntive

What do we offer?

• 6 weeks of holidays per year (plus option to buy 10 extra)

• 40-hour work week with flexitime (capped at 45 hours)

• A hybrid work setup with flexibility to work remotely

• Generous parental leave: 18 weeks for maternity and 6 weeks for paternity/adoption

• SBB Half-Fare Card and first-class travel between SMG offices in Switzerland

• Gender-neutral pay and transparent career paths

• Choose your gear: Mac or Windows laptop, and iPhone, Samsung, or Pixel mobile

• An inclusive and innovative environment where your voice matters

Recruitment Process
We keep hiring simple and human (mind this is a Corporate Communication Manager role, expect to be challenged):

• Initial Video-Call with one of our Recruiters (Video 30 min)

• Interview with the Hiring Manager (Video 60 min)

• Technical Interview (Video 45 min)

• Team Fit Conversation and meeting relevant Business Stakeholders (Onsite 60 min)

Apply now

To take advantage of this great opportunity, please send us your detailed CV and feel free to include any supporting documents that will help us understand why you are the perfect fit.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant que Corporate Communication Manager, vous ferez partie de l’équipe Corporate Communication & Public Affairs et contribuerez à renforcer la réputation de SMG grâce à une communication claire, cohérente et percutante.

Sous la responsabilité du responsable de la communication d'entreprise et des affaires publiques, vous travaillerez sur un large éventail de sujets de communication d'entreprise au niveau du groupe, avec un accent particulier sur les relations avec les médias et la communication financière. Vous soutiendrez également les communications internes et certains projets de communication stratégique, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les relations avec les investisseurs, la haute direction et les responsables de la communication de nos unités commerciales.

Responsabilités

• Soutenir le développement et la mise en œuvre de stratégies et de concepts de communication d'entreprise alignés sur les objectifs commerciaux de SMG.

• Gérer les activités de relations avec les médias, y compris les demandes de renseignements des médias, la surveillance des médias, les communiqués de presse, les déclarations, les questions et réponses et les activités des porte-parole.

• Gérer les relations avec les médias et les activités de relations publiques pour l'activité Finance et Assurance de SMG, en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes concernées.

• Soutenir la communication financière en étroite collaboration avec les Relations Investisseurs, notamment les résultats annuels et semestriels, le rapport annuel et l'assemblée générale annuelle.

• Soutenir le positionnement des cadres supérieurs à travers des messages clés, des points de parole, des présentations et du contenu de communication.

• Soutenir la communication interne sur des sujets à l'échelle du groupe et adapter le contenu aux groupes cibles et canaux internes pertinents.

• Soutenir la communication sur des sujets et des projets stratégiques à l'échelle du Groupe, tels que la durabilité et la cybersécurité.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la haute direction, les responsables de la communication des unités commerciales et d'autres parties prenantes internes clés

• Coordonner les agences et partenaires externes si nécessaire

## Qualifiche

• Baccalauréat ou Master (FH, Université) en communication, journalisme, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe

• 5+ années d'expérience en communication d'entreprise

• Expérience en relations avec les médias et bonne compréhension du paysage médiatique suisse

• Expérience ou fort intérêt pour les communications financières et sur les marchés des capitaux

• Excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et éditoriales et capacité à traduire des sujets complexes en une communication claire et adaptée au groupe cible.

• Confiance dans le travail avec des parties prenantes de haut niveau et dans le traitement de sujets de communication sensibles ou urgents

• Solides compétences organisationnelles et capacité à gérer plusieurs sujets et délais en parallèle

• Style de travail pragmatique, pratique et collaboratif avec un haut niveau de fiabilité et une attention portée à la qualité.

• Intérêt pour les modèles économiques numériques et le secteur technologique

• Allemand et anglais courants obligatoires, écrits et parlés

## Informations supplémentaires

Que proposons-nous ?

• 6 semaines de vacances par an (plus possibilité d'en acheter 10 supplémentaires)

• Semaine de travail de 40 heures avec horaires flexibles (plafonnés à 45 heures)

• Une configuration de travail hybride avec la flexibilité de travailler à distance

• Congé parental généreux : 18 semaines pour la maternité et 6 semaines pour la paternité/adoption

• Carte demi-tarif CFF et voyages en première classe entre les agences SMG en Suisse

• Rémunération neutre en matière de genre et parcours de carrière transparents

• Choisissez votre équipement : ordinateur portable Mac ou Windows et mobile iPhone, Samsung ou Pixel.

• Un environnement inclusif et innovant où votre voix compte

Processus de recrutement
Nous continuons à recruter de manière simple et humaine (attention, il s'agit d'un rôle de Corporate Communication Manager, attendez-vous à être mis au défi) :

• Appel vidéo initial avec l'un de nos recruteurs (Vidéo 30 min)

• Entretien avec le responsable du recrutement (Vidéo 60 min)

• Entretien technique (Vidéo 45 min)

• Conversation en équipe et rencontre avec les parties prenantes concernées (sur site, 60 minutes)

Postulez maintenant

Pour profiter de cette formidable opportunité, veuillez nous envoyer votre CV détaillé et n'hésitez pas à inclure toutes les pièces justificatives qui nous aideront à comprendre pourquoi vous êtes la personne idéale.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In qualità di Staff Frontend Engineer, sarai un leader tecnico pratico con un impatto a livello aziendale sul nostro Real Estate verticale. Potrai modellare ed evolvere l'architettura frontend che alimenta i nostri portali, creare soluzioni frontend condivise adottate da più squadre, e orchestrare iniziative complesse.

Incontra la squadra!
A SMG, la nostra forza sta nella nostra gente. Incontra il Manager con il quale potresti lavorare:

• Yuliya Zvolskaya - Engineering Manager - LinkedIn

A un livello elevato, si:

• Impostare la direzione tecnica per frontend in più team, allineamento costruzione tra ingegneri, product manager, designer e stakeholder senior.

• Influenza roadmap, decisioni di investimento e priorità di ingegneria collegando strategia di frontend ai risultati aziendali, rischio di consegna e impatto del cliente.

• Definire e guidare la cultura dell'eccellenza ingegneristica , mentre leader l'evoluzione della nostra architettura di frontend Real Estate per supportare le esigenze future, impostare e migliorare SLAs/SLOs e anticipare gli effetti increspature tra sistemi insieme ad altri ingegneri e principi.

• Agire come leader tecnico di fiducia in team e sedi per argomenti di frontend, plasmando come le esperienze web sono costruite attraverso la nostra organizzazione e influenzando le decisioni sia a livello di team che di leadership.

• Rappresentare l'ingegneria di frontend in discussioni interfunzionali e di leadership, aiutando l'organizzazione a migliorare i trade-off tecnici a lungo termine.

• Progettare e creare librerie di frontend condivise, componenti e strumenti (ad esempio sistema di progettazione, monitoraggio delle prestazioni) ampiamente utilizzati dai team interni, concentrandosi su soluzioni pragmatiche e riutilizzabili e guidando la loro adozione.

• Orchestrare refactors multi-sistema e migrazioni come gli aggiornamenti quadro, armonizzazione cross-product.

• Mentore e allenatore di altri ingegneri attraverso la mentorship strutturata, l'accoppiamento e il feedback, aiutandoli a crescere le loro abilità e chiudendo le lacune di abilità che osservate nell'organizzazione organizzando allenamenti strutturati per la nostra gente.

• Modelli una cultura di feedback sana, aiutando le persone a navigare conversazioni dure e conflitti in modo costruttivo e incolpabile.

• Sfida e migliora i processi di team e cross-team, suggerendo cambiamenti che migliorano la messa a fuoco, la qualità e la velocità quando necessario.

• Scriverai ancora un sacco di codice, ma il tuo impatto sarà misurato tanto da come si moltiplica l'efficacia degli altri come dalla vostra uscita individuale.

Il tuo giorno per giorno

• Sarete parte di un team di prodotti, tempo di divisione circa la metà e la metà tra consegna del prodotto e responsabilità del personale, a seconda delle esigenze attuali e priorità

• Innovare, progettare, implementare e distribuire soluzioni ingegneristiche orientate al fronte per i nostri prodotti, dalla scoperta alla produzione.

• Costruire l'allineamento tra team con obiettivi e vincoli diversi, e sbloccare i progressi su iniziative ambigue e cross-cutting. Entra per creare chiarezza, slancio e proprietà condivisa quando necessario.

• Proprio la visione tecnica end-to-end per i viaggi chiave dell'utente come Homegate e Immoscout24 e altro ancora, con un forte focus sulle prestazioni, l'accessibilità, la qualità UX e l'affidabilità

• Iniziative di frontend cross-team (per esempio: miglioramenti del sistema di progettazione condiviso, armonizzazione UI cross-brand, bilanci di performance o modelli di osservabilità).

• Identificare e ritagliare colli di bottiglia tecnici di superficie, come ad esempio le prestazioni trascina nel core viaggio utente o inefficienze di tempo di costruzione, e sostenere la loro risoluzione a livello di leadership.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con Product, Design e altri team di ingegneria per modellare la strategia tecnica e i trade-off per nuove funzionalità e lavori di piattaforma

• Partner con DevX per co-sviluppare l'ingegneria 'blueprints' e schede di valutazione della salute, impostando lo standard d'oro per quello che 'good' sembra nei nostri repository frontend

• Valutare, prototipo e introdurre nuove tecnologie e approcci di frontend (frameworks, tooling, pattern), documentare i risultati e guidare l'adozione dove hanno senso

• Possedere ed evolvere il processo Frontend ADR, assicurando che le decisioni tecniche siano documentate, socializzate e implementate in modo coerente in tutta la nostra organizzazione

• Guidare e rivedere il lavoro di altri ingegneri attraverso recensioni di progettazione, recensioni di codice, gilda e coaching informale.

• Aiuta il team ad abbracciare e sfruttare i modelli AI & Large Language nei nostri flussi di lavoro e prodotti di ingegneria

• Contribuire e facilitare il frontend guild, chat di tecnologia, e altri formati di condivisione di conoscenze cross-team

• Promuovere una cultura dell'ingegneria di alta qualità: test, monitoraggio con Datadog, osservanza, sicurezza e eccellenza operativa

As a Staff Frontend Engineer , you'll be a hands-on technical leader with company-level impact across our Real Estate vertical. You’ll shape and evolve the frontend architecture powering our portals, create shared frontend solutions adopted by multiple teams, and orchestrate complex initiatives.

Meet the team!
At SMG, our strength lies in our people. Meet the Manager with whom you could work:

• Yuliya Zvolskaya - Engineering Manager - LinkedIn

At a high level, you will:

• Set technical direction for frontend across multiple teams, building alignment among engineers, product managers, designers and senior stakeholders.

• Influence roadmaps, investment decisions, and engineering priorities by connecting frontend strategy to business outcomes, delivery risk and customer impact.

• Defining and driving the culture of engineering excellence , while leading the evolution of our Real Estate frontend architecture to support future requirements, setting and improving SLAs/SLOs and anticipating ripple effects across systems together with other engineers and principals.

• Act as a trusted technical leader across teams and locations for frontend topics, shaping how web experiences are built across our organisation and influencing decisions at both team and leadership levels.

• Represent frontend engineering in cross-functional and leadership discussions, helping the organisation make better long-term technical trade-offs.

• Design and create shared frontend libraries, components and tooling (e.g. design system, performance monitoring) that are widely used by internal teams, focusing on pragmatic, reusable solutions and driving their adoption.

• Orchestrate multi-system refactors and migrations like framework upgrades, cross-product harmonisation.

• Mentor and coach other engineers through structured mentorship, pairing, and feedback, helping them grow their skills and closing skill gaps you observe in the organisation by organising structured trainings for our people.

• Model a healthy feedback culture, helping people navigate tough conversations and conflicts in a constructive, blameless way.

• Challenge and improve team and cross-team processes , suggesting changes that improve focus, quality, and speed when needed.

• You’ll still write plenty of code, but your impact will be measured just as much by how you multiply the effectiveness of others as by your individual output.

Your day-to-day

• You'll be part of a product team, splitting time about half and half between product delivery and staff responsibilities, depending on the current needs and priorities

• Innovate, design, implement, and deploy frontend-focused engineering solutions for our products, from discovery to production.

• Build alignment across teams with different goals and constraints, and unblock progress on ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives. Step in to create clarity, momentum, and shared ownership when needed.

• Own the end-to-end technical vision for key user journeys like Homegate and Immoscout24 and more, with a strong focus on performance, accessibility, UX quality, and reliability

• Lead cross-team frontend initiatives (for example: shared design system improvements, cross-brand UI harmonisation, performance budgets, or observability patterns).

• Identify and surface cross-cutting technical bottlenecks, such as performance drags in the core user journey or build-time inefficiencies, and advocate for their resolution at the leadership level.

• Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other engineering teams to shape technical strategy and trade-offs for new features and platform work

• Partner with DevX to co-develop engineering 'blueprints' and health scorecards, setting the gold standard for what 'good' looks like in our frontend repositories

• Evaluate, prototype, and introduce new frontend technologies and approaches (frameworks, tooling, patterns), document your findings, and drive adoption where they make sense

• Own and evolve the Frontend ADR process, ensuring technical decisions are documented, socialised, and consistently implemented across our organisation

• Guide and review the work of other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, guild, and informal coaching.

• Help the team embrace and leverage AI & large language models in our engineering workflows and products

• Contribute to and facilitate the frontend guild, tech chats, and other cross-team knowledge-sharing formats

• Promote a culture of high-quality engineering: testing, monitoring with Datadog, observability, security, and operational excellence

Our Tech Stack
You’ll work primarily on the frontend, while collaborating with fullstack engineers:

• Frontend: mainly Vue.js and some React, both with TypeScript as the language of choice. We run a mix of client-side, server-side, pre-rendered, and hybrid web apps

• Backend: Node.js and TypeScript, serverless and microservices architecture in a cloud-based environment using AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, and more)

• Monitoring & Observability: Mainly Datadog plus logging/alerting best practices

• AI & Tooling: We actively adopt the latest developments in AI technology and expect you to embrace innovation offered by large language models in your daily work

## Qualifiche

• 8+ years of professional experience with the Vue.js or similar frameworks

• Proven track record of implementing and maintaining automated frontend testing, using tools such as Jest, Vitest, and/or Cypress

• Experience collaborating with designers using Figma (figma.com)

• Strong experience building and evolving large-scale frontend applications in modern JavaScript/TypeScript

• Proven track record of senior technical leadership in a Staff, Lead, or equivalent role : leading complex cross-team initiatives, aligning diverse stakeholders, influencing decisions without direct authority, and taking responsibility from strategy through rollout and iteration.

• Deep understanding of modern CI/CD for frontend, including automated release strategies and feature flagging in a microfrontend environment.

• Demonstrated experience creating and driving adoption of shared frontend solutions (e.g. design system components, shared libraries, cross-cutting tooling)

• Demonstrated experience influencing multiple teams or an entire product area, including driving alignment, adoption, and durable technical change across various teams.

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or tech leads, and raising the technical bar through coaching, feedback, and role modelling.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Engineering- and Product leadership, as well as non-technical partners.

• Evidence of defining a technical strategy and turning it into execution across teams.

• Excellent English communication skills, spoken and written.

• You can explain complex topics clearly to different audiences in an international team setting

We value engineers who:

• Thrive in collaborative environments and are true team players

• Have a growth mindset and are curious, we love growing together

• Are passionate about frontend architecture and building & scaling cloud-based solutions

• Are open to change and able to propose pragmatic solutions, not just point out problems

• Feel free to challenge the status quo when it improves outcomes for users or the organisation.

• Are creative, adaptable, and enjoy solving complex, ambiguous problems

You will stand out if you have:

• Significant professional experience in software development (including time in senior/lead roles)

• Deep experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (Vue.js, React, or similar)

• Solid hands-on experience building production applications with Vue 3

• Strong understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO considerations for large user-facing sites

• Prior working experience with APIs and microservices and how frontend apps best integrate with them

• Prior working experience with cloud service providers like AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud experience with server-side rendering / hybrid rendering patterns and edge / CDN optimisation

• Du stärkst die fachliche Qualität durch klare Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Arbeitsrichtlinien und gezieltes Coaching im Team.

## Qualifiche

• Berufserfahrung im Produktmanagement, in der Prozessentwicklung, im Business Process Engineering oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion sowie ausgewiesene Erfahrung im Customer Support oder Customer Service, idealerweise in digitalen Kundenprozessen. Du hast komplexe Fälle und Eskalationen verantwortet und an Prozessverbesserungen mitgewirkt.

• Sehr gutes Verständnis digitaler Kundenprozesse, des Qualitätsmanagements und fachlicher Entscheidungsfindung. Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte klar, bewertest Risiken und vertrittst Entscheidungen adressatengerecht.

• Ausgeprägte AI-Affinität und Interesse, neue AI-Anwendungen fachlich mitzugestalten.

• Sehr gute analytische, konzeptionelle und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen einzubeziehen und Entscheidungen voranzubringen.

• Deutsch und Englisch mündlich und schriftlich fliessend (mindestens C1); Französisch oder Italienisch ab B2-Niveau von grossem Vorteil

Was dich auszeichnet
Du erkennst Zusammenhänge zwischen Kundenanliegen, digitalen Produkten und internen Abläufen. Du bringst vernetztes Denken, analytische Neugier und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen mit. Dabei behältst du die Bedürfnisse der Kund und die tägliche Realität des Supports im Blick.
Deine Aufgaben entwickeln sich mit unseren Produkten, Prozessen und AI-Anwendungen weiter.

## Informazioni aggiuntive

Das bieten wir dir

• 6 Wochen Ferien (mit der Möglichkeit, bis zu 10 zusätzliche Tage zu kaufen)

• 40-Stunden-Woche

• 18 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub und 6 Wochen Vaterschaftsurlaub. Gilt auch bei Adoption.

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle (Work-Life-Balance ist uns sehr wichtig)

• Zugang zu Plattformen für mentale Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und Beratung

• Halbtax-Abonnement für den öffentlichen Verkehr und 1.-Klasse-Reisen mit dem Zug zwischen den SMG-Standorten in der Schweiz

Bewerbungsverfahren

Wir betrachten den Einstellungsprozess als einen gegenseitigen Austausch, in dem sich beide Seiten kennenlernen. Das erwartet dich:

• Videointerview mit Recruiter (30 min.)

• Videointerview mit Hiring Manager inkl. technischem Assessment (60 min.)

• Team Fit Meeting (45 min.)

In this role, you will own and transform the consumer experience for seekers and private listers into a decisive competitive advantage for SMG Real Estate , driving demand liquidity, conversion quality, and long-term marketplace trust.
You will work at the intersection of product management, growth, and marketplace economics , with a clear mandate: to turn fragmented consumer journeys into a cohesive, data-driven system of action that materially improves both user outcomes and business performance.
This is one of the most impactful product leadership roles in European real estate marketplaces , with direct influence on demand-side strategy and company growth.
Your Main Tasks:

• Lead a team of Product Managers responsible for the end-to-end consumer and private lister journey, from discovery to transaction.

• Define and execute a clear, opinionated product strategy for consumers, grounded in marketplace dynamics such as liquidity, trust, and conversion.

• Drive measurable improvements in demand-side performance, including engagement, lead quality, conversion, and retention.

• Partner closely with commercial leadership to accelerate growth of the private listers segment and unlock new value pools.

• Design and continuously evolve team topology and ownership domains aligned to strategy, not legacy structures.

• Establish rigorous OKRs and an effective operating cadence, linking product bets to business impact with clear success and stop criteria.

• Build a high-velocity, insight-driven product culture by leveraging experimentation, data, and AI to shorten learning loops.

• Coach and develop Product Managers into top-tier product leaders, raising the bar on product craft, judgment, and accountability.

• Represent the consumer domain in executive and board-level discussions, shaping company-wide priorities.
Your Responsibility:

• Directly lead around 5 Product Managers, with potential to expand scope.

• Own a critical revenue and growth driver within the business unit.

• Influence cross-functional teams across design, engineering, data, and commercial functions.

• Be accountable for defining and prioritizing multi-million CHF investment areas.
You will work closely with:

• Business Unit leadership, including the GM, Commercial, and Marketing teams.

• Engineering, Design, and Data leadership.

• Other Product leads across SMG marketplaces.

• External partners where relevant, such as data, integrations, and AI tooling providers.

## Qualifiche

You have a strong product leadership background and know how to build, scale, and improve consumer-facing digital products. You are comfortable turning strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and effective execution across teams.
Ideally, you bring:
Experience and background

You have around 8-12+ years of experience in Product Management, including meaningful leadership responsibility. You have successfully owned and scaled digital products, preferably in marketplaces, classifieds, platforms, or other consumer-facing businesses.
A degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field is helpful, but not a must. We also value candidates with non-traditional, interdisciplinary, or hands-on product backgrounds.
Product and business skills

You bring strong product judgment and know how to focus on what truly matters for users and the business. You understand consumer behavior, funnels, growth mechanics, and how to use data to make better product decisions.
You are able to work at both strategic and executional levels; from shaping product direction to ensuring high-quality delivery. You are confident defining metrics, interpreting signals, and translating insights into action.
Ways of working

You have experience working in complex, cross-functional environments and are skilled at aligning stakeholders across product, engineering, design, business, and senior leadership. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, creating clarity, and bringing people with you.

You bring a high ownership mindset, a bias for action, and a strong sense of accountability.
Tools, AI, and language skills

You are familiar with modern product, analytics, and experimentation tools. You also understand how AI can be applied practically in product development, personalization, and internal efficiency with a focus on real value rather than hype.

Fluency in English is required, as it is our business language. German is a plus, but not required.

• 6 weeks of holidays per year (plus option to buy 10 extra)

• 40-hour work week with flexitime (capped at 45 hours)

• A hybrid work setup with flexibility to work remotely

• SBB Half-Fare Card and first-class travel between SMG offices in Switzerland

• Gender-neutral pay and transparent career paths

• Choose your gear: Mac or Windows laptop, and iPhone, Samsung, or Pixel mobile

• An inclusive and innovative environment where your voice matters

We keep hiring simple and human:

Apply now!

responsibilities.

Support data models, platforms, pipelines, governance practices, data quality approaches, and integration patterns.

Drive customer-focused innovation and support new ways of working in software development by identifying, evaluating, and responsibly integrating AI and GenAI capabilities.

decision records, and best practices for long-term maintainability.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.

Experience:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in software engineering, technical architecture, solution architecture, or a comparable role.

• Proven track record of working across complex systems and supporting teams through the full software delivery lifecycle.

• Fluency in German and English is required. The role requires the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with customers, understand their business needs, and translate these into pragmatic technical solutions.

Dich erwartet ein engagiertes und vielfältiges Team mit einer ausgeprägten Sales-Mentalität und viel gegenseitiger Unterstützung. Wir arbeiten flexibel in einem hybriden Modell.
